description: This bar chart presents two side-by-side comparisons of accuracy percentages for two datasets, PHHEME and PolitiFact, across six different experimental configurations. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 75.0 to 95.0 in increments of 2.5, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists the six configurations: “Ours”, “w/o comments”, “w/o text”, “w/o select”, “w/o emotion”, and “w/o cognition”, ordered from left to right. Each bar is color-coded and labeled with its exact accuracy percentage. For the PHHEME dataset, the “Ours” configuration achieves 89.84%, “w/o comments” achieves 86.82%, “w/o text” achieves 80.10%, “w/o select” achieves 88.80%, “w/o emotion” achieves 87.34%, and “w/o cognition” achieves 87.17%. For the PolitiFact dataset, “Ours” achieves 90.57%, “w/o comments” achieves 85.85%, “w/o text” achieves 83.02%, “w/o select” achieves 89.62%, “w/o emotion” achieves 84.91%, and “w/o cognition” achieves 87.74%. The bars are grouped by dataset, with PHHEME on the left and PolitiFact on the right, separated by a vertical dashed line. Each bar’s height corresponds to its labeled accuracy value, and there are no visual emphases like shading or bolding beyond the standard bar representation.
